I added cross-trace **Link** support to MLflow tracing across three files (source only — no tests touched).

### `mlflow/entities/link.py` (new)
A `Link` class with `trace_id`, `span_id`, and optional `attributes` (default `None`). Provides `to_dict()` returning exactly `{"trace_id", "span_id", "attributes"}` and a `from_dict()` classmethod where `attributes` defaults to `None` when absent.

### `mlflow/entities/__init__.py`
Imported `Link` and added it to `__all__` so `from mlflow.entities import Link` works.

### `mlflow/entities/span.py`
- **`_links`**: a plain list initialized in `Span`, `LiveSpan`, and `NoOpSpan`.
- **`links` property**: returns a `deepcopy` of stored links so mutations don't leak; returns `[]` for v4 (Unity Catalog) trace IDs regardless of stored links.
- **`LiveSpan.add_link(link)`**: validates (`tr-<hex>` trace_id; hex span_id ≤ 16 chars) raising `MlflowException` matching `"Invalid link"`; clones the link on insert; forwards it to the underlying OTel span using integer trace/span IDs.
- **`to_dict()`**: adds a `"links"` key (list of link dicts, `[]` when none).
- **`from_dict()`**: reconstructs links via `Link.from_dict()`.
- **`from_otel_proto()`**: populates links from the proto (`tr-`+lowercase hex trace_id, lowercase hex span_id, deserialized attributes); skips links entirely when `location_id` is provided.
- **`to_otel_proto()`**: round-trips links back to proto bytes from the stored hex strings.
- **`to_immutable_span()`**: deep-copies `_links`.

The SQLAlchemy store round-trips automatically since it serializes the full `span.to_dict()` (including `links`) as content and rebuilds via `Span.from_dict()` — `translate_span_when_storing`/`translate_loaded_span` preserve the `links` key.
